scenarios.name: Successfully send a friend request
scenarios.description: User A sends a request to User B. The request is recorded, and both receive a confirmation message.

sourceReferences.note: Business logic for sending friend request
Entry point for sending friend request

scenarios.name: Fail when target user does not exist
scenarios.description: The friend request fails if the target user ID or nickname cannot be resolved.

scenarios.name: Fail when already friends
scenarios.description: User cannot send a friend request to someone they are already friends with.

scenarios.name: Fail when request already pending
scenarios.description: User cannot send a friend request if one has already been sent to that user.

scenarios.name: Fail when target user is blocked
scenarios.description: User cannot send a friend request if the target is blocked or the user is blocked by the target.
